My name is Peacekeeper, and I was referred to you by Skier. Let us not waste time and get straight to business. I need to deliver certain equipment for certain people. I am going to provide you with everything required. Your task is to leave the goods in a designated location. On the coast, next to one of the... what is the Russian word?.. Ah! Breakwaters. There is a boar there. Leave everything inside.}} ==Requirements== * Must be Loyalty Level 2 to start this quest ==Objectives== * Locate the boat hidden next to the breakwater on [[Shoreline]] * Stash the [[MF-UNTAR body armor]] in the boat * Stash the [[Leatherman Multitool|multitool]] in the boat ==Rewards== * +10,000 [[EXP]] * [[Peacekeeper]] Rep '''+0.1''' * Dollars ** Dollars with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 1,347 Dollars with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 {{quote|My contacts received everything they needed. Good job, will be glad to work with you more, mercenary.}} ==Initial Equipment== {|class="wikitable" !Icon !Item name !Amount !Notes |- |[[File:UNTARArmorIcon.png|link=MF-UNTAR body armor]] |[[MF-UNTAR body armor]] |1 |Needs to be placed at the secret spot |- ![[File:Multitoolicon.png|link=Leatherman Multitool]] |[[Leatherman Multitool]] |1 |Needs to be placed at the secret spot |} ==Guide== In this quest you have to stash the 2 specified items in a rowboat at the beach near the gas station on [[Shoreline]]. After accepting the quest you will be sent a [[MF-UNTAR body armor]] and a [[Leatherman Multitool]] via in-game mail. The [[Leatherman Multitool]] is not lootable from players and persists upon death as long as it is placed in a special item slot. Each item takes 10 seconds to stash.
